> **Not yet implemented.** In the current build this command prints
> `diff: not implemented yet` and exits with code 2.

## Usage

```text
provenance diff <ref-a> <ref-b> [flags]
```

Produce a rendered/semantic diff between two git refs, for the whole repository or one entity.

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--entity id` | — | limit the diff to the entity with this id |
